I love seeing your toddler-friendly versions 🧡  Here’s the full recipe for my viral pumpkin stuffed buns 🍂 🧡 Soft, cozy, and toddler-safe , naturally sweetened and full of calm autumn vibes. ✨ What you’ll need (makes 9 mini pumpkins): 🌾 Dough: – 2 cups (260g) spelt flour – ½ cup (120g) pumpkin purée (thick and cool) – 1 egg – 1 tbsp honey (15g) – 1 tbsp soft butter or neutral oil (15g) – ½ tsp dry yeast (2g) – pinch of salt – ¼ tsp cinnamon (optional) 🍯 Filling: – 5–6 Medjool dates (90g), soaked – 2 tbsp peanut butter (30g) – 2 tbsp ground mixed seeds (sunflower, pumpkin, sesame) – ½ tsp cinnamon – 1 tsp honey (optional) 🎃 Bake at: 180°C for 15–18 min (oven) or 170°C for 12–14 min (air fryer) After baking, add a tiny date stick as the pumpkin stem 🍁 #toddlerfriendly #pumpkinrecipe #fallbaking #toddlerrecipes #nosugaradded
